name: handoff
summary: Agent skill that compacts the current conversation into a handoff document for the next agent.
description: SKILL.md that has an agent write a handoff document to the OS temp directory: what was done, which skills the next agent should invoke, and references to existing artifacts (specs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, diffs) by path or URL instead of repeating them. API keys, passwords and personal data are redacted before the handoff.
contains: writes the handoff doc to the OS temp directory ($TMPDIR, /tmp, %TEMP%)
adds a suggested skills section for the next agent
references existing artifacts by path or URL instead of duplicating them
redacts API keys, passwords and personal data
